args.body:
src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.publicUrl or the configured application URL rather than process.env.PUBLIC_URL with a hardcoded localhost fallback, or correctly reference the application configuration for BASE_URL so password reset emails point to the production domain instead of localhost:3000.
args.title: Fix password reset email link pointing to localhost
